name: dm-interactive-table
description: Interactive digital table for D&D campaigns with DM control panel, real-time map sync, and AI-assisted storytelling.

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.test:smoke: npm run prisma:generate --workspace server && node scripts/smoke-test.js
scripts.verify:core: npm run build && npm run lint --workspace client && npm run docs:validate && npm run release:check && npm run test:vision && npm run test:camera && npm run test:layers && npm run test:device && npm run test:performance && npm run test:assets && npm run test:security && npm run test:recovery && npm run test:workflow && npm run prisma:validate --workspace server && npm run test:smoke
scripts.verify: npm run verify:core && npm run test:e2e:run

author: Joel Martinez
